parameters.name: AddrPoolId
parameters.description: The ID of the address pool.

parameters.name: EvaluationCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of consecutive exceptions detected. If the number of consecutive exceptions detected reaches the maximum number, the application service is deemed abnormal.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The health check interval. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the values of specific response parameters. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: MonitorExtendInfo
parameters.description:
The extended information. The required parameters vary based on the value of ProtocolType.

*   HTTP or HTTPS

    *   port: the port that you want to check

    *   host: the host settings

    *   path: the URL path

    *   code: the response code. The health check result is deemed abnormal if the returned value is greater than the specified value.

    *   failureRate: the failure rate

    *   sni: specifies whether to enable server name indication (SNI). This parameter is available only when ProtocolType is set to HTTPS. Valid values:

        *   true: enables SNI.
        *   false: disables SNI.

    *   nodeType: the type of the node for monitoring when Type is set to DOMAIN. Valid values:

        *   IPV4
        *   IPV6

*   PING

    *   failureRate: the failure rate

    *   packetNum: the number of ping packets

    *   packetLossRate: the loss rate of ping packets

    *   nodeType: the type of the node for monitoring when Type is set to DOMAIN. Valid values:

        *   IPV4
        *   IPV6

*   TCP

    *   port: the port that you want to check

    *   failureRate: the failure rate

    *   nodeType: the type of the node for monitoring when Type is set to DOMAIN. Valid values:

        *   IPV4
        *   IPV6

parameters.name: ProtocolType
parameters.description:
The health check protocol. Valid values:

*   HTTP
*   HTTPS
*   PING
*   TCP

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns add-dns-gtm-monitor --lang en --addr-pool-id po00 --protocol-type TCP --interval 60 --evaluation-count 1 --timeout 3000 --monitor-extend-info failureRate_:50,_port_:80 --isp-city-node CityCode=123 IspCode=123 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns AddDnsGtmMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --IspCityNode.1.CityCode 123 --ProtocolType TCP --Timeout 3000 --AddrPoolId po00 --EvaluationCount 1 --Lang en --MonitorExtendInfo 'failureRate_:50,_port_:80' --IspCityNode.1.IspCode 123 --Interval 60
